query:
UPDATE notification_digest_receipt_cleanup
            SET claim_token = NULL,
                claim_expires_at = NULL,
                safe_after = now() + make_interval(
                    secs => LEAST(300, power(2, LEAST(attempt_count, 8))::integer)
                ),
                updated_at = now()
            WHERE notification_id = $1
              AND user_id = $2
              AND generation = $3
              AND claim_token = $4
